title: Onboard nova-lite-4b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard nova-lite-4b v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, GPU performance profiles, and automated changelog generation. Context and motivation: nova-lite-4b is a compact 4B variant requested for latency-sensitive endpoints and cost-conscious Dedicated tiers. This PR: adds canonical model metadata manifest (parameters, tokenizer hints, recommended quantization), adds validated perf profiles for G4/G5/T4 classes including KV cache heuristics and recommended batch sizes, wires changelog automation (metadata:changelog="auto") to the release pipeline, and includes unit tests and docs updates. Performance summary (internal harness perf-2025-01-09-893210): G5-16 single GPU: 12.6 tokens/sec steady state (p99 210ms); G4dn single GPU: 7.8 tokens/sec (p99 340ms); T4 int8: 9.1 tokens/sec (~18% cost reduction vs fp16). See perf YAMLs for batch breakdown and tolerances. Tests: perf-profile schema validation, changelog template formatting, and end-to-end staging smoke run. CI: registry-lint, perf-profile-validate, changelog-gen all pass after re-run.
commits_summary: 5 commits: add metadata manifest; add perf profiles for g4/g5/t4; changelog automation hook and template; unit tests for profile validation; docs quickstart and guidance.
release_notes: Onboarded nova-lite-4b v1.0 — compact 4B model optimized for low-latency endpoints. Includes recommended quantization, perf profiles for G4/G5/T4, and tooling to auto-generate changelog entries for model registry updates.
